item.title: Updated Staffing & Office Hours
item.description: We are BACK to our old office hours! Over the past Summer, we scaled back those hours, while we were operating with reduced staffing. We are please to announce that we are back up to previous staffing levels, after bringing Willem up to full time. And as a reflection of that, we've extended hours back to where they were prior to last Summer. item.title: WLUD Community Radio Update!
item.description: A lot is still happening behind the scenes to get WLUD community radio off the ground. In March 2027, WLUD will need to be broadcasting locally on 93.3 FM, and we know we want to be streaming online well before then, so that we can get the operational workflow down, and have time to get the programming in order, show hosts & DJs trained, and all of the other things that will inevitably come up. item.title: Town Meeting Coverage
item.description: Beginning this Saturday, we will start our busiest few days of the year, with the coverage of all of the annual Town Meetings in the 6 Towns we serve. We will be in Reading & Cavendish on Saturday and then on Monday evening, we will have crews out in Andover, Ludlow, Mount Holly, & Plymouth. We now have our broadcast schedule for the 6 different meetings, which you can find HERE.
